title: Mother Barbara Holding Baby Kent in Garden, 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A charming mid-20th-century deckle-edged outdoor snapshot showing a young mother identified as Barbara sitting in a backyard folding chair with her baby son, Kent. Barbara wears 1940s-era pin curls, eyeglasses, a crisp short-sleeved collared shirt, and dark trousers, holding the diapered infant securely on her lap. The setting is an earthy home garden bordered by rocks, newly cultivated soil beds, and a garden hose, capturing an intimate glimpse of everyday postwar American domestic life.
